subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add general max-age and max-turn automatic session rotation, and what config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines public lifecycle config and behavior for preserving session state across automatic resets, which automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Opt-In Lifecycle Policy
options.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory, transcript, route, and provider continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Session Boundaries
options.body: Keep this issue open as a requirement but implement it only as part of the broader session-boundary and pruning design.

options.title: Defer Automatic Rotation
options.body: Document cron, context-pruning, daily/idle reset, and manual reset mitigations while avoiding new core lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Lifecycle Policy
recommendation.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory, transcript, route, and provider continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across daily reset and pre-compaction memory flush, so they are the best available owner for the product boundary.
